---
title: "ZLifts Dashboard"
format: dashboard
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
repo_root <- normalizePath(file.path(".."), mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(repo_root, "scripts", "source-analysis.R"))
source_zlifts(repo_root)

sets <- read_lifting_sets(file.path(repo_root, "data", "processed", "lifting_sets.csv"))
validation <- validate_lifting_data(sets)
exercise_summary <- summarize_exercises(sets)
session_summary <- summarize_sessions(sets)

metric_workouts <- nrow(session_summary)
metric_sets <- sum(session_summary$total_sets, na.rm = TRUE)
metric_reps <- sum(session_summary$total_reps, na.rm = TRUE)
metric_volume <- sum(session_summary$total_volume_lb, na.rm = TRUE)
metric_latest <- max(session_summary$date, na.rm = TRUE)

session_table <- session_summary |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Date = format(.data$date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    `Activity ID` = .data$activity_id,
    Sets = .data$total_sets,
    Reps = .data$total_reps,
    `Total volume` = scales::comma(.data$total_volume_lb)
  )

validation_table <- validation |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Status = tools::toTitleCase(.data$status),
    Check = gsub("_", " ", .data$check),
    Message = .data$message,
    Count = .data$n
  )
```

# Overview

## Summary

```{r}
bslib::layout_column_wrap(
  width = "180px",
  bslib::value_box("Workouts", scales::comma(metric_workouts), theme = "primary"),
  bslib::value_box("Recorded sets", scales::comma(metric_sets), theme = "secondary"),
  bslib::value_box("Repetitions", scales::comma(metric_reps), theme = "success"),
  bslib::value_box("Total volume", paste(scales::comma(metric_volume), "lb"), theme = "info"),
  bslib::value_box("Latest workout", format(metric_latest, "%b %d, %Y"), theme = "warning")
)
```
